description: Land Acquisition - Madawala, Pathadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the compulsory acquisition of eight specific land allotments for a public purpose. The content is exclusively focused on land matters, providing detailed descriptions of the properties, their locations, extents, and the legal process for interested parties to claim compensation. It does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
